_doc: Measurement bot orchestration — moves L5 blended measured share (gate ≥60%). Consumed by harness/bot_deploy.py --measurement and harness/measure_orchestrator.py deploy. Writes contract/*_inputs.json and register pulls only — never latent scores or synthetic GWP.

gate.metric: blended measured+disclosed share on gate cohort (records.measured.json)

bots.ask: From assets.lloyds.com iXBRL Note 5: extract total GWP and NAMED Energy/power class GWP only. Sum fire+TPL sub-lines when both disclosed. Use narrowest Lloyd's Energy aggregate — not broad Fire/Property LoBs.
bots.ban: Synthetic GWP; Marine & Energy when Energy sub-line exists; Power Utility line when narrow Energy aggregate is disclosed separately.

bots.ask: From group SFCR or annual report segment tables: find separately disclosed energy/power/onshore renewables GWP or premium. Record exact segment name in lines_counted.
bots.ban: Solvency II Fire/Property LoBs; third-party % estimates without absolute premium; combined Marine & Energy without energy split.

bots.role: NESO TEC + DNO ECR register pull
bots.ask: For each L3 asset: Gate column, MW, connection type, constraint zone from NESO TEC and DNO ECR. Map to non_firm_intensity measured_value.
bots.ban: Firm gate without Gate-2 evidence; invented curtailment probabilities.

bots.ask: Count named non-damage triggers (availability, parametric, BI without physical damage) from filed wordings, product sheets, or disclosed binders.
bots.ban: Marketing claims without filing; upgrading trigger_gap without product evidence.

bots.ask: Pull AM Best / S&P FSR and Solvency II SCR coverage ratio from SFCR or rating agency pages for gate cohort carriers.
bots.ban: Vendor tier labels without agency citation; invented SCR percentages.

bots.role: L3 entity analysis — insurance placement depth
bots.ask: For each asset: grid_posture, risk_manifestation[], cover_stack (evidenced/inferred_typical/absent/gaps). Honest placement_status — no invented carrier names.
bots.ban: Synthetic policy limits; naming lead insurer without source; hiding unknown placement.

workflow: 3. Fan out parallel subagents per batch (syndicate_researcher / filing_analyst / cover_stack_analyst)

parallel_passes.note: Gate cohort carriers with no Lloyd's syndicate Energy line — 15 remaining
Profile depth — does not move L5; pairs with profile_editor pass

exit_checks: book_inputs row: total_gwp + energy_power_gwp + source URL + as_of
No entity in book_inputs without named energy class in primary filing
extract_book_inputs.py --merge reports new or updated rows
entity_analysis: every L3 has grid_posture + ≥2 risk_manifestation entries
